name: 95th St. Farmers Market
tagline: Naperville Park District, 95th Street Library hosting outdoor market
description: 95th St. Farmers Market is a farmers market in 3015 Cedar Glade Drive Naperville, IL, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
